name: 224. Replay and routing fidelity: thinking order, mcp server_label, served tier on chat streams, bare sonar routing (replay-routing-fidelity)
description: Wire pins for four gateway fixes. 224.1: a replayed Cohere reasoning transcript with reasoning after assistant text must keep thinking ahead of text in every assistant message (Cohere 400s otherwise); the transcript is sent in full so it does not depend on an MCP agent loop. 224.2: chat requests served through the Responses API (gpt-6-astra) must carry service_tier on the streamed chunks (128.3 pins the non-streaming body). 224.3/224.4: bare perplexity/sonar on /v1/responses is routed to /chat/completions like the sonar-* models. 224.5/224.6: mcp_list_tools / mcp_call items keep server_label in the response and on replay (152.1 pins the response side only). The decisions tool_choice gate for cohere/command-a-reasoning is pinned by the existing /v1/decisions jev-anchor case for that model.

item.name: 224.1 cohere/command-a-reasoning /v1/responses replay with reasoning after assistant text and a tool turn keeps thinking first - replay-routing-fidelity

exec: // A replayed agent turn can carry reasoning AFTER an assistant text item (user, reasoning, message,
// reasoning, function_call, function_call_output). Pre-fix the converter appended that second reasoning to
// the finished text message, and Cohere 400s: "content items of type 'thinking' ... must come before items
// of other types". Post-fix it opens a new assistant turn carrying the thinking and the tool call.
var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('224.1 exact success status', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'replay failed: ' + txt).to.equal(200);
pm.test('224.1 Cohere did not reject the thinking order', function () {
pm.expect(txt, 'thinking-order rejection').to.not.include('must come before');
var body = {}; try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
pm.test('224.1 response has output', function () {
pm.expect(body.output, 'expected output array: ' + txt.slice(0, 600)).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty;
var rr = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('224.1 every outbound assistant message puts thinking before any other content', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honoured').to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(rr.messages, 'raw_request.messages missing: ' + JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 600)).to.be.an('array');
rr.messages.forEach(function (m, i) {
if (m.role !== 'assistant' || !Array.isArray(m.content)) { return; }
var seenOther = false;
m.content.forEach(function (c, j) {
if (c.type === 'thinking') { pm.expect(seenOther, 'messages[' + i + '].content[' + j + '] is thinking after other content: ' + JSON.stringify(m).slice(0, 600)).to.equal(false); }
else { seenOther = true; }
pm.test('224.1 the replayed tool call reached Cohere', function () {
var calls = (rr && rr.messages || []).filter(function (m) { return m.role === 'assistant' && Array.isArray(m.tool_calls) && m.tool_calls.length; });
pm.expect(calls.length, 'no assistant tool_calls message on the wire: ' + JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 800)).to.be.at.least(1);

item.name: 224.2 openai/gpt-6-astra /v1/chat/completions streaming service_tier fast: chunks echo the served tier - replay-routing-fidelity fast-service-tier

exec: // gpt-6-astra chat is served through the Responses API. Pre-fix the Responses->chat conversion never
// copied service_tier, so the chat body and every chunk came back without it and the log row billed
// at Standard rates. x-bf-expect-cost lets the dbverify reporter recompute the cost at the served tier.
var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('224.2 exact success status', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + txt).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('224.2 response is SSE', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('content-type') || '').to.include('event-stream');
var lastTier = null; var chunks = 0;
txt.split('\n').forEach(function (line) {
if (line.indexOf('data:') !== 0) { return; }
var ev; try { ev = JSON.parse(line.slice(5)); } catch (e) { return; }
if (!ev || ev.object !== 'chat.completion.chunk') { return; }
chunks++;
if (ev.service_tier) { lastTier = ev.service_tier; }
pm.test('224.2 stream carries chat.completion.chunk events', function () {
pm.expect(chunks, 'no chat chunks: ' + txt.slice(0, 800)).to.be.above(0);
pm.test('224.2 a chunk echoes the served tier (fast, or default if OpenAI downgraded)', function () {
pm.expect(lastTier, 'no chunk carried service_tier: ' + txt.slice(-800)).to.be.oneOf(['fast', 'default']);

item.name: 224.3 perplexity/sonar /v1/responses bare sonar is served from chat completions - replay-routing-fidelity

exec: // Perplexity's /v1/responses rejects the Sonar family (`model "sonar" is not supported`); only sonar-*
// was routed to /chat/completions, so bare sonar 400ed. Post-fix it is served via chat and converted back.
var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('224.3 exact success status', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + txt).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('224.3 upstream did not reject the model', function () { pm.expect(txt).to.not.include('is not supported'); });
var body = {}; try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
pm.test('224.3 Responses-shaped body with output', function () {
pm.expect(body.object, txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql('response');
pm.expect(body.output, 'expected output array').to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty;
var rr = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('224.3 the wire request is chat-shaped (messages, not input)', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honoured').to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(rr.messages, 'outbound body: ' + JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 600)).to.be.an('array');
pm.expect(rr.input, 'outbound body still Responses-shaped').to.equal(undefined);

item.name: 224.5 openai/gpt-4o-mini responses mcp tool output keeps server_label for replay (mcp tool) - replay-routing-fidelity

exec: // server_label sat on two embedded structs at the same depth, so the JSON codecs dropped it both ways:
// the mcp_list_tools / mcp_call items came back without it, and replaying them made OpenAI 400.
var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('224.5 exact success status', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + txt).to.equal(200); });
var body = {}; try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
var items = body.output || [];
var mcpItems = items.filter(function (o) { return typeof o.type === 'string' && o.type.indexOf('mcp_') === 0; });
pm.test('224.5 output has mcp_* items and each carries server_label deepwiki', function () {
pm.expect(mcpItems.length, 'no mcp_* items: ' + txt.slice(0, 800)).to.be.above(0);
mcpItems.forEach(function (o) { pm.expect(o.server_label, 'server_label dropped on ' + o.type + ': ' + JSON.stringify(o).slice(0, 400)).to.eql('deepwiki'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('mcpServerLabelReplayInput222', JSON.stringify([
{ type: 'message', role: 'user', content: 'Use the deepwiki tool to ask what the facebook/react repo is about, one sentence.' }
].concat(items).concat([{ type: 'message', role: 'user', content: 'Thanks. Now say only DONE.' }])));

item.name: 224.6 openai/gpt-4o-mini responses replay of mcp_list_tools and mcp_call items is accepted (mcp tool) - replay-routing-fidelity

exec: // Replays 224.5's output verbatim. An unresolved {{mcpServerLabelReplayInput222}} is not valid JSON, so a
// missing capture fails here loudly rather than passing.
var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('224.6 exact success status', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'replay failed: ' + txt).to.equal(200); });
var body = {}; try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
var rr = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('224.6 every replayed mcp_* input item reached OpenAI with its server_label', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honoured').to.be.an('object');
var mcpIn = (rr.input || []).filter(function (o) { return o && typeof o.type === 'string' && o.type.indexOf('mcp_') === 0; });
pm.expect(mcpIn.length, 'no mcp_* items in the outbound input: ' + JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 800)).to.be.above(0);
mcpIn.forEach(function (o) { pm.expect(o.server_label, 'server_label dropped on ' + o.type).to.eql('deepwiki'); });
